name: Death of Ms. Coral
descriptionTemplate:
{Team Unique}: Whenever one of the wielder's cards is played, gain Shield equal to [StateArg1]% of the wielder's DEF, plus another [StateArg2]% of their DEF for each Tentacle.
This effect triggers only once each turn.
lore:
She had never dreamed.

The young apprentice sculptor believed firmly in absolute rationality and order, just like the cold, lifeless works she created.
From the moment she first laid eyes on it, she was captivated. Soft and pure, it was the perfect coloring material.
By moonlight, she worked tirelessly, carrying the black goo from the graveyard back to her studio.
A week later, a sculpture titled "@2" was displayed at the fair.

That night, she heard the distant sound of waves.
For the first time, she dreamed.
Beneath the tranquil light of morning, a dust-covered underwater palace lay peacefully asleep. She wandered among clusters of white coral, breathing in an atmosphere heavy with loneliness and oblivion.

When she awoke, her fingers had begun to curl and turn black. Eventually, white coral sprouted from them.
She held the coral to her nose again and again, sensing the murmurs of ancient times—the countless whispers of creatures that had long since passed away.
It was a truly soft fossil.
Nervously, she began to laugh. 
"So this is what dreaming feels like."

She locked herself in her studio and began creating obsessively.

Molding. Sculpting. Coloring...
Chaotic yet orderly. Inorganic yet organic.

She would dream forever.
